records.original_stem:
A pharmacist has been expired solely for ordinary nonrenewal, with no suspension or revocation for 1 months. The pharmacist wants to resume work in Massachusetts. Assume this duration is measured after the applicable expiration or order date.

Which description best fits the applicable restoration pathway? Select ONE answer.
